## Summary
- move the site to the new `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` comments build contract
- add workflow-side comments defaults plus the reusable discussion ID resolver
- forward only `SEPO_COMMENTS_*`, `SEPO_PREVIEW_*`, and `HYPOTHESIS_*` repository variables into builds
- document the best-effort/strict comments behavior for this example site

## Operational note
This repo currently has old `GISCUS_*` repository variables. Because this change intentionally does not support legacy aliases, migrate repo/Vercel configuration to `SEPO_COMMENTS_*` before or with merge if we want to preserve the current Site comments category:

```bash
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_ENABLED --body true --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO --body self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO_ID --body R_kgDOSxuc6Q --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY --body "Site comments" --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY_ID --body DIC_kwDOSxuc6c4C-jIx --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
gh variable set SEPO_COMMENTS_TRIGGER_MODE --body bot --repo self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms
```

## Validation
- `npm run check`
- `SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO=self-evolving/repo-discussions SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO_ID=R_kgDOSjgnjQ SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY=General SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY_ID=DIC_kwDOSjgnjc4C9gaF SEPO_PREVIEW_PR=77 SEPO_PREVIEW_BRANCH=agent/demo npm run build`
